name: Contura
description: Melodic contour over selectable 12-TET scale sets, anchored to the device tonic

sections.heading: Faders
items: Main — interval width (stepwise ↔ 2–3 octave leaps across the pool)
Third (Btn hold) — note density (sparse rests ↔ continuous; audible mid)

sections.heading: Scale sets / LEDs
items: Flat list of named 12-TET sets (Ionian…Folk) — conventional interval-pattern labels, not cultural claims
Follow device tonic (default on); Follow device scale uses the global Key mask instead of the selected set
Per-set melodic feel (contour / leap / sustain / ornament) — expressivity is not a fader
Ornaments = short grace, turn or repeat from feel + phrase position — not genre clichés; off when Division is too fine
Button hue cycles by scale index · Top = gate · Bottom = pitch height · Division via config (default 1/8)
Jack = CV Out (pitch) · CV In Density · CV In Interval · CV In Reset · CV In Phrase — one enum, since a CV In destination and CV Out were never live at once; CV Att scales input

channels.jackDescription: CV Out: quantized melodic pitch (1V/oct / range). CV In: modulates Density, Interval or Phrase, or Reset (gate) — Dest + Att in Configurator. Gate is MIDI note on/off.
channels.faderDescription: Max scale-degree step — bottom stepwise, mid already leaps, top wanders 2–3 octaves when octave span allows
channels.faderPlusShiftDescription: How many steps before the contour resets (3–28)
channels.faderPlusFnDescription: How often notes fire vs rests — sparse ↔ continuous, mid already densifies
channels.fnDescription: Short press mutes/unmutes. Long press steps to the next scale set.
channels.fnPlusShiftDescription: Shift+Short = octave span 1→4 · Shift+Long = previous scale set
channels.ledBottom: Pitch height within the current span
